result.instructions: Tools for PlentyONE, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders from the last 3 days are still unpaid?"; "Show order 4711 with its addresses, payments and comments."; "Which variations have less than 5 pieces in stock in warehouse 1?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PlentyONE data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run plentymarkets_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run plentymarkets_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run plentymarkets_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. plentymarkets_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (sales orders, returns, credit notes ...) with filters. Newest first with sort_by createdAt and sort_order desc. Returns {page, totalsCount, isLastPage, entries[]}; each entry has the id, typeId (1 = sales order), statusId, plentyId, createdAt, amounts and the order items unless add_order_items is false. GET /rest/orders.

status_from.description: Only orders in this status or a higher one (status ids are numbers like 3, 5.1, 7).

status_to.description: Only orders up to this status (combine with status_from for a range).

order_type.description: Order type id(s), comma separated: 1 sales order, 2 delivery order, 3 returns, 4 credit note, 5 warranty, 6 repair, 7 offer, 8 advance order, 9 multi order, 10 multi credit note, 11 multi delivery, 12 reorder, 13 partial delivery, 14 subscription, 15 redistribution.

referrer_id.description: Only orders from this order referrer / marketplace (see plentymarkets_list_order_referrers).

external_order_id.description: The order id the marketplace or shop gave the order.

included_variation.description: Only orders that contain this variation id.

created_from.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or a date-time (2026-10-24T13:33:23+02:00). A bare date means the whole day.

created_to.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or a date-time (2026-10-24T13:33:23+02:00). A bare date means the whole day.

updated_from.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or a date-time (2026-10-24T13:33:23+02:00). A bare date means the whole day.

updated_to.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or a date-time (2026-10-24T13:33:23+02:00). A bare date means the whole day.

paid_from.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or a date-time (2026-10-24T13:33:23+02:00). A bare date means the whole day.

paid_to.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or a date-time (2026-10-24T13:33:23+02:00). A bare date means the whole day.

add_order_items.description: Include the order items (default true). false makes the page much smaller.

with.description: Related data to load, for example addresses, comments, payments, documents.

items_per_page.description: Entries per page, 1 to 100 (default 25). When is_last_page is false, ask for the next page.

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id: status, amounts, dates, properties, order items, address relations. Add related data with `with` (addresses, comments, payments, documents, shippingPackages ...). GET /rest/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_order_status_history
tools.description: The status changes of an order: which status, when, and by which user. GET /rest/orders/{orderId}/status-history.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_order_statuses
tools.description: The order statuses defined in the system (id and name per language), to translate a statusId. Optionally a range of status ids. GET /rest/orders/statuses.

language.description: Two-letter language code, for example en or de.

items_per_page.description: Entries per page, 1 to 100 (default 50). When is_last_page is false, ask for the next page.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_order_referrers
tools.description: The order referrers (sales channels: shop, eBay, Amazon, ...) with their ids, for the referrer_id filter of plentymarkets_list_orders. GET /rest/orders/referrers.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_comments
tools.description: The comments (internal notes) on an order, an order item, a contact or a category. GET /rest/comments/{referenceType}/{referenceValue}.

reference_id.description: The id of the order, order item, contact or category.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_items
tools.description: List items (the product containers) with filters. Prices, stock, barcodes and SKUs belong to the variations: use plentymarkets_list_variations for those. Returns {page, totalsCount, isLastPage, entries[]}. GET /rest/items.

name.description: Item name (matches the name of the item).

updated_from.description: Only items updated from this day on (yyyy-mm-dd).

updated_to.description: Only items updated up to this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

lang.description: Language of the texts, a two-letter code (default: the system's).

with.description: Related data: itemProperties, itemCrossSelling, variations, itemImages, itemShippingProfiles.

items_per_page.description: Entries per page, 1 to 100 (default 25). When is_last_page is false, ask for the next page.

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_item
tools.description: Get one item by id: flags, manufacturer, texts, condition, age rating and the item-level settings. GET /rest/items/{itemId}.

lang.description: Language of the texts, a two-letter code.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_variations
tools.description: Search variations (the sellable products: number, SKU, barcodes, prices, stock, categories). Filter by item, number, barcode, SKU, active flag, category, warehouse. Use `with` for the related data (variationSalesPrices, variationBarcodes, stock, variationCategories, images ...). GET /rest/items/variations.

number_fuzzy.description: Variation numbers that contain this text.

stock_warehouse_id.description: Only variations with physical stock in this warehouse.

updated_from.description: Only variations updated from this day on (yyyy-mm-dd).

updated_to.description: Only variations updated up to this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

items_per_page.description: Entries per page, 1 to 100 (default 25). When is_last_page is false, ask for the next page.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_categories
tools.description: List item categories (the category tree: id, parent, level, type, names with `with` details). GET /rest/categories.

with.description: details = names and texts, clients = the stores the category is active in, tags.

items_per_page.description: Entries per page, 1 to 100 (default 50). When is_last_page is false, ask for the next page.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_manufacturers
tools.description: List the manufacturers (brands) of the items: id, name, address data. GET /rest/items/manufacturers.

items_per_page.description: Entries per page, 1 to 100 (default 50). When is_last_page is false, ask for the next page.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_sales_prices
tools.description: List the sales price configurations (price types such as retail or purchase price: id, type, names, which stores, countries and currencies they apply to). The prices of a variation: plentymarkets_list_variations with variationSalesPrices. GET /rest/items/sales_prices.

items_per_page.description: Entries per page, 1 to 100 (default 50). When is_last_page is false, ask for the next page.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_stock
tools.description: List physical stock per variation and warehouse (physical stock, net stock, reserved, reorder level), optionally for one variation or changed since a date. Returns {page, totalsCount, isLastPage, entries[]}. GET /rest/stockmanagement/stock.

updated_from.description: Only stock changed from this date on.

updated_to.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd) or a date-time (2026-10-24T13:33:23+02:00). A bare date means the whole day.

items_per_page.description: Entries per page, 1 to 200 (default 50). When is_last_page is false, ask for the next page.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_warehouses
tools.description: List the warehouses (id, name, type, priority, address settings). GET /rest/stockmanagement/warehouses.

tools.name: plentymarkets_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, suppliers, ...). Returns personal data of your customers (names, emails, addresses). Filter by email, name, number, type, postal code or town; `with` adds addresses, options (email, phone), accounts, orderSummary. GET /rest/accounts/contacts.

full_text.description: Full text search over the contact data.

type_id.description: Contact type: 1 customer, 2 interested party, 3 sales representative, 4 supplier, 5 manufacturer, 6 partner.

items_per_page.description: Entries per page, 1 to 100 (default 25). When is_last_page is false, ask for the next page.

tools.name: plentymarkets_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id (customer personal data). Add addresses or accounts with `with` (the relations documented for this single-contact route). GET /rest/accounts/contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: plentymarkets_add_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal comment to an order, order item, contact, category or variation (an additive note, nothing is overwritten). By default the comment is NOT visible to the customer; only make it visible when the user explicitly asks. POST /rest/comments.

reference_id.description: The id of the order, order item, contact, category or variation.

visible_for_contact.description: Show the comment to the customer (default false: internal only).

tools.name: plentymarkets_update_order_status
tools.description: WRITE: move an order to another status. This can trigger the event procedures configured in the system (customer emails, stock bookings, documents, shipping), so confirm the target status with the user first (plentymarkets_list_order_statuses has the ids). Only the status is sent. PUT /rest/orders/{orderId}.

status_id.description: The target status id, for example 5 or 7.2.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with PlentyONE
prompts.description: What you can do with PlentyONE here, with example requests to try.
